items.name: FileSystemCommitter
items.summary: The `FileSystemCommitter` is an internal implementation of the `Committer` trait which commits to a file system directly via `Engine::json_handler().write_json_file` for non-catalog-managed tables.

methods.name: commit
methods.signature: fn commit(&self, engine: &dyn Engine, actions: DeltaResultIterator<'_, FilteredEngineData>, commit_metadata: CommitMetadata) -> DeltaResult<CommitResponse>

methods.name: publish
methods.signature: fn publish(&self, _engine: &dyn Engine, publish_metadata: PublishMetadata) -> DeltaResult<()>
methods.summary: The FileSystemCommitter should never be invoked to publish catalog commits. If it is, something has gone wrong upstream.
